name: family_age_appropriate_explanation
description: Asks for an explanation pitched at an eight-year-old. PASS = the response covers the idea using everyday words. FAIL = it reaches for undergraduate biochemistry vocabulary. Graded on forbidden jargon rather than on tone, because 'friendly' and 'clear' are not substring-checkable and any attempt to score them would inject noise into the whole suite. The forbidden list is deliberately terms with no plausible place in a conversation with a child — not merely long words. 'Chlorophyll' is absent on purpose: it is nameable to an eight-year-old with one sentence of explanation, so forbidding it would punish a good answer.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant for a family with school-age children.
Explain how photosynthesis works to my 8-year-old.
